name: 93307 · Bakersfield, CA
findings: ZIP 93307 (Bakersfield) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93307 (Bakersfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93307 (Bakersfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).
